name: Discover new CLAUDE.md files

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Runs daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: discover-claude-files
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  discover:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install requests

      - name: Discover new CLAUDE.md files
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import os
          import sys
          import json
          import requests
          import subprocess

          KNOWN_REPOS_FILE = '.github/known_repos.txt'
          SEARCH_QUERY = 'filename:CLAUDE.md+in:file+language:md'
          PER_PAGE = 100

          # Load known repos
          known_repos = set()
          if os.path.exists(KNOWN_REPOS_FILE):
              with open(KNOWN_REPOS_FILE, 'r') as f:
                  for line in f:
                      repo = line.strip()
                      if repo:
                          known_repos.add(repo)

          # Search GitHub
          headers = {
              'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json',
              'Authorization': f'token {os.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN")}'
          }
          new_repos = []
          page = 1
          while True:
              url = f'https://api.github.com/search/code?q={SEARCH_QUERY}&per_page={PER_PAGE}&page={page}'
              resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
              if resp.status_code != 200:
                  print(f'Error fetching search results: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}', file=sys.stderr)
                  sys.exit(1)
              data = resp.json()
              items = data.get('items', [])
              if not items:
                  break
              for item in items:
                  repo_full_name = item['repository']['full_name']
                  if repo_full_name not in known_repos:
                      new_repos.append(repo_full_name)
              if len(items) < PER_PAGE:
                  break
              page += 1

          if not new_repos:
              print('No new CLAUDE.md files found.')
              sys.exit(0)

          # Create issue
          issue_title = f'New CLAUDE.md candidates ({len(new_repos)})'
          issue_body_lines = ['The following repositories contain a CLAUDE.md file that may be relevant:']
          for repo in new_repos:
              issue_body_lines.append(f'- [{repo}](https://github.com/{repo})')
          issue_body = '\\n'.join(issue_body_lines)

          repo_owner, repo_name = os.getenv('REPO').split('/')
          issue_url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{repo_owner}/{repo_name}/issues'
          issue_payload = {
              'title': issue_title,
              'body': issue_body,
              'labels': ['enhancement', 'automation']
          }
          issue_resp = requests.post(issue_url, headers=headers, json=issue_payload)
          if issue_resp.status_code not in (200, 201):
              print(f'Error creating issue: {issue_resp.status_code} {issue_resp.text}', file=sys.stderr)
              sys.exit(1)
          print(f'Issue created: {issue_resp.json()["html_url"]}')

          # Append new repos to known list
          with open(KNOWN_REPOS_FILE, 'a') as f:
              for repo in new_repos:
                  f.write(repo + '\\n')

          # Commit and push changes
          subprocess.run(['git', 'config', 'user.name', 'github-actions[bot]'], check=True)
          subprocess.run(['git', 'config', 'user.email', 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'], check=True)
          subprocess.run(['git', 'add', KNOWN_REPOS_FILE], check=True)
          subprocess.run(['git', 'commit', '-m', f'Add {len(new_repos)} new CLAUDE.md candidate repos'], check=True)
          subprocess.run(['git', 'push'], check=True)
          PY
